title: Cloud voice agents told: no push, pull updates, never block

owner_note.text: Cloud voice agents now get "no push, pull `updates` every turn, never block" in the server instructions, spawn_agent/wait_for_agent/updates/wake_me descriptions and the guide. Open: cloud text agents on /mcp/remote are indistinguishable from voice (both `voice-app`); I proposed `register_session kind` but did not build it. Mastermind role now says size wake-ups to the job and check in every 1-2 min (you may want to veto that wording).
